# Nine Hours (ナインアワーズ)

> > Japan's innovative capsule hotel chain combining minimalist accommodation with sleep-tech research and wellness services.

Nine Hours operates a network of capsule hotels across Japan while pioneering sleep analysis technology through partnerships with Yamaha and universities. The company offers both hospitality services and the 9h sleep checkup program for health monitoring.

## Key Topics

- Capsule hotel accommodation
- 9h sleep checkup service
- Sleep-tech and wellness technology
- Yamaha sleep analysis partnership
- Hotel locations (Narita Airport, Hakata, Shinjuku, Ningyocho, Shinagawa)
- Booking platforms (Rakuten, Jalan, Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia)
- Sleep analysis and health monitoring
- Minimalist hotel design
- University research partnerships
- ISMS compliance and data protection
- Japanese accommodation standards
- Wellness-focused hospitality
